root_cause: COMPOSIO_API_KEY was correctly stored as a Netlify production secret, but powerhouse-social-publisher executes in Supabase. The existing admin onboarding route only copied a user-supplied key from the browser into Supabase, so adding the key to Netlify alone did not make it available to the publishing runtime.
prevention_rule: A production secret required by a runtime must be projected into that runtime through an authenticated server-to-server binding. Never assume that a secret configured in Netlify is visible to Supabase. The bridge must read the Netlify secret only in server runtime, call the existing validated Supabase onboarding route, expose no secret value, perform a status preflight to avoid redundant writes, and execute before the daily publish window.
evidence: Netlify production environment contains a secret COMPOSIO_API_KEY updated on 2026-09-21.
Supabase bg_geheim('COMPOSIO_API_KEY') returned absent before repair.
powerhouse-content-closed-loop-v1 is active every five minutes but cannot use Composio primary transport until Supabase receives the validated key.
terminal_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN only after exact-head gates, protected merge, production Netlify deploy, scheduled-function presence/readback, Supabase api_key_present=true and Composio setup status readback without exposing secret material.
